name: 2/3A

dimensions.note: GP publishes a nominal 17.0 by 28.5mm with sleeve; Emmerich lists 16.5 +/-0.5 by 28.0 +/-0.5mm for its flat-top battery. The lithium CR-2/3A (CR17335) is a different size, 17mm by 33.5mm.

variants.notes: GP lists 500 cycles to IEC 61951-2. Emmerich lists 3.3A continuous and 11A momentary maximum discharge for its version.

interchange.note: The lithium CR17335 is also sold as 2/3A but is 5mm longer and runs at 3V, not 1.2V.

safety: Charge only with a charger designed for nickel-metal hydride batteries; overcharging can cause venting or leakage.
Batteries meant for pack assembly are not sold with protection circuits; do not short circuit or heat above the rated temperature.
Do not mix batteries of different capacity, age or charge state in one pack.
notes: The nickel-metal hydride 2/3A is about 28mm long; lithium batteries sold under the same name are 33.5mm long.
